svg.aria-label: Forest creek scene with 12 numbered items. Biotic (living or once living): 1 redwood tree, 2 banana slug, 3 fungi on log, 4 fallen log and dead leaves (once living), 5 deer, 6 bacteria in soil. Abiotic (nonliving): 7 sunlight, 8 air temperature, 9 creek water, 10 rocks, 11 soil minerals, 12 wind. Trap: dead leaves and logs are biotic (once living).
svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Biotic and abiotic factors in a redwood forest creek scene
svg.text: Biotic and abiotic factors: a redwood forest creek

text.tspan: dead leaves and logs are BIOTIC (once living).
